title: WISDOM_RECEIPT_V1
description: A single $1/60-second question-and-answer transaction record for the Flywheel of Wisdom workflow. In this build, every field marked mock_* documents that no real payment or wallet event occurred - the receipt is real (deterministically generated, replay-verifiable), but the payment behind it is synthetic.

replay_id.description: SHA-256 of the canonical receipt content (excluding receipt_id/replay_id/timestamp themselves). Re-deriving this from the same question+answer content must produce the same value - that is what makes the receipt replay-verifiable rather than just a claim.

share_artifact_path.description: Local file path to the generated share markdown. NOT a public URL - no hosting exists yet in this build.

mock_payment.description: is_mock is hard-locked to true at the schema level - this receipt type cannot represent a real payment without a new schema version, matching the same const-locking convention used elsewhere in this project.
